article.title: Big 12 matchup features No. 24 Arizona playing TCU
article.linkText: Big 12 matchup features No. 24 Arizona playing TCU
article.story: TCU (4-4) at No. 24 Arizona (6-2), Nov. 6 at 10:15 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Arizona by 8.5. Against the spread: Arizona 3-5, TCU 3-4-1. How to watch: ESPN Key stats Arizona Offense Overall: 455.6 yards per game (17th in FBS) Passing: 324.1 yards per game (6th) Rushing: 131.5 yards per game (104th) Scoring: 34.9 points per game (29th) Arizona Defense Overall: 334.5 yards per game (47th in FBS) Passing: 199.8 yards per game (49th) Rushing: 134.8 yards per game (60th) Scoring: 18.9 points per game (27th) TCU Offense Overall: 390.5 yards per game (64th in FBS) Passing: 275.9 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 114.6 yards per game (120th) Scoring: 23.3 points per game (100th) TCU Defense Overall: 287.6 yards per game (14th in FBS) Passing: 174.6 yards per game (15th) Rushing: 113 yards per game (29th) Scoring: 14.1 points per game (8th) TCU is 22nd in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 31.4% of third downs. TCU is 116th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 76.7% of trips. Arizona's red zone defense ranks 5th at 70%. Arizona is 23rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:14. Team leaders Arizona Passing: Noah Fifita, 2,481 yards, 19 TDs, 4 INTs, 74.1 completion percentage Rushing: Kedrick Reescano, 321 yards on 89 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Mizell, 675 yards on 34 catches, 6 TDs TCU Passing: Jaden Craig, 2,207 yards, 11 TDs, 6 INTs, 65.1 completion percentage Rushing: Jeremy Payne, 429 yards on 88 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Kari Ashley, 560 yards on 38 catches, 4 TDs Last game Arizona lost 34-26 to Texas Tech on Oct. 31. Fifita passed for 417 yards on 33-of-45 attempts (73.3%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Reescano carried the ball nine times for 18 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding three receptions for 16 yards. Mizell had seven receptions for 182 yards and one touchdown. TCU won 22-16 over Kansas on Oct. 31. Craig passed for 141 yards on 13-of-29 attempts (44.8%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 87 yards and one rushing touchdown. Ace Theus had 30 rushing yards on two carries and one touchdown. Ashley had three receptions for 50 yards. Next game Arizona hosts No. 3 Utah on Nov. 14. TCU hosts Kansas State on Nov. 14.
